episode.logline: Cornered and chained in the damp dungeon, Juliana shatters Catherine's cruelty with unshakeable dignity and the truth about love and worth, driving Catherine into a murderous fury.
episode.continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 31's cliffhanger where Catherine used a glowing branding iron to scorch Juliana's mother's herbal book.

events.label: SOUND FX:
events.text: Sizzling, crackling sound of scorched parchment paper.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up on the open botanical ledger lying on the wet stone floor as the glowing red branding tip sizzles against the delicate parchment.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana, chained against the brick wall, tears glistening on her cheeks as she trembles in grief.

events.label: CATHERINE (Mocking, Savoring):
events.text: "There it is."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle medium shot of Catherine in her opulent velvet gown, clutching the hot poker with a sadistic sneer.

events.label: CATHERINE (Whispering, Venomous):
events.text: "Fear."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward over the burning book, eyes glittering with malice.

events.label: CATHERINE (Taunting):
events.text: "You have been so proud of that brave little face..."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Wide shot showing Juliana chained against the cold dungeon wall, small and restrained beneath Catherine's towering shadow.

events.label: CATHERINE (Smug, Dominant):
events.text: "...but now you are afraid."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Catherine straightening up haughtily.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana, her lips trembling in agonizing sorrow.

events.label: CATHERINE (Cruel, Final):
events.text: "Say goodbye to your mother."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle shot of Catherine swinging the flaming orange iron upward from the book.

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Juliana's despair suddenly solidifies. Her jaw tightens, tears stopping as resolve takes over.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana looking up directly at Catherine, fear replaced by cold conviction.

events.label: JULIANA (Defiant, Unbroken):
events.text: "Burn it."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of Juliana, sitting upright despite her heavy iron shackles.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine, her smug expression abruptly flickering with startled confusion.

events.label: CATHERINE (Disconcerted):
events.text: "What?"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle close-up of Juliana staring straight up into Catherine's eyes without flinching.

events.label: JULIANA (Firm, Resolute):
events.text: "Burn the ledger. Burn every page."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Wide shot of the wet dungeon floor, guards stationed by the heavy iron doorway in the background as Catherine holds the hot brand.

events.label: JULIANA (Steely, Proud):
events.text: "You may destroy the book..."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine's face darkening with irritation.

events.label: JULIANA (Transcendent, Defiant):
events.text: "...you cannot destroy what my mother taught me."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium low-angle shot of Juliana sitting amidst chains beneath the barred ceiling grate.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine leaning down aggressively into Juliana's space, trembling with offended rage.

events.label: CATHERINE (Spiteful, Hissing):
events.text: "You think a few herbs make you better than me?"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana looking steadily up into Catherine's furious glare.

events.label: JULIANA (Calm, Cutting):
events.text: "No. Your cruelty does that for me."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: High-angle over-the-shoulder shot looking down at Juliana bound in heavy chains on the damp floor.

events.label: CATHERINE (Furious, Shouting):
events.text: "You still think you are better?!"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Extreme close-up of Catherine, baring her teeth in outrage.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Juliana, her chained hands clasped together in her lap.

events.label: JULIANA (Serene, Grounded):
events.text: "I know what I am."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Catherine scoffing with forced, derisive laughter.

events.label: CATHERINE (Sneering, Mocking):
events.text: "A disgraced woman?"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana speaking with undeniable strength.

events.label: JULIANA (Unwavering):
events.text: "A woman who survived. You cannot destroy me."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine brandishing the glowing tong in Juliana's face, spittle flying from her lips.

events.label: CATHERINE (Screaming, Enraged):
events.text: "You are lying!"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana looking straight up, voice steady and clear.

events.label: JULIANA (Measured, Emphatic):
events.text: "Gerald leaving me was the best thing he ever did for me."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Full shot of the dungeon cell. Catherine stands rigidly tall while Juliana sits shackled on the ground.

events.label: JULIANA (Contemplative, Scathing):
events.text: "He wanted a woman who looked beautiful beside his wealth."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's expressive blue eyes and tear-stained cheek.

events.label: JULIANA (Passionate, Clear):
events.text: "He wanted a wife whose family could raise his name. He measured a woman's worth by what she could give him."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle shot of Juliana leaning slightly forward against her chains.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine staring down, her eyes widening as Juliana's words pierce her facade.

events.label: JULIANA (Unapologetic, Victorious):
events.text: "Let him have Clarissa."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana smiling with genuine liberation.

events.label: JULIANA (Proud):
events.text: "He lost me."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Extreme close-up of Catherine's face contorting in sheer fury.

events.label: CATHERINE (Shrieking, Vicious):
events.text: "You were rejected!"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana's calm, resolute face.

events.label: JULIANA (Grounded, Powerful):
events.text: "I was freed. And I found a man who never asked me what I was worth."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Wide shot of the cell, steam rising faintly in the cold subterranean air.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine sneering with dripping condescension.

events.label: CATHERINE (Disdainful):
events.text: "Your soldier?"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glowing with genuine devotion.

events.label: JULIANA (Tender, Certain):
events.text: "My husband."

events.label: CATHERINE (Bitter):
events.text: "He is a nobody."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine scowling with deep disgust.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana smiling softly, totally untroubled.

events.label: JULIANA (Warm, Defiant):
events.text: "Then I love a nobody."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle shot focusing on Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron on the stone floor.

events.label: JULIANA (Resonant, Moving):
events.text: "Because that nobody showed me more love than your entire world ever did."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of Catherine gripping the branding rod tighter, her upper lip curling in fury.

events.label: CATHERINE (Indignant, Sharp):
events.text: "You know nothing about my world."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Juliana sitting in her tattered apron and chains, looking composed.

events.label: JULIANA (Knowing, Sober):
events.text: "I know exactly what your world values."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's lips and eyes as she lists them with chilling precision.

events.label: JULIANA (Listing, Deliberate):
events.text: "Beauty. Money."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Extreme close-up of Catherine's wide, stunned eyes reacting to the naked truth.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana looking up unflinchingly.

events.label: JULIANA (Firm):
events.text: "Family. A perfect name."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle shot of Catherine standing rigid in her gold and purple gown, the guard standing sentinel behind her.

events.label: JULIANA (Continuing):
events.text: "And a woman who never embarrasses the people standing behind her."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine throwing her hands up in explosive defensiveness.

events.label: CATHERINE (Shouting, Outraged):
events.text: "And what is wrong with that?!"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine's face twisting in absolute venom.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana looking serene.

events.label: JULIANA (Gentle, Penetrating):
events.text: "Nothing. Until you have nothing left beneath it."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Catherine standing motionless, holding the iron rod, struck to the core by the insult.

events.label: JULIANA (Unrelenting):
events.text: "You have spent your whole life collecting things that make people bow..."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle shot of Juliana's chained hands folded peacefully in her lap.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of Juliana looking up with quiet pity.

events.label: JULIANA (Piercing):
events.text: "...but you have never learned how to make anyone love you."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Catherine snapping entirely, raising the branding poker like a weapon and screaming.

events.label: CATHERINE (Hysterical, Screaming):
events.text: "Silence! Silence!"

events.label: CATHERINE (Shrieking):
events.text: "Why?!"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine's crazed, gasping face.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana crying out her defiance.

events.label: JULIANA (Forceful):
events.text: "Because I am right!"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle tracking shot of the red-hot branding tip trailing across the wet dungeon floor, steaming.

events.label: JULIANA (Scathing, Direct):
events.text: "You want everyone to believe you are powerful."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Juliana sitting under the cold skylight bars, her posture majestic despite her imprisonment.

events.label: JULIANA (Continuing):
events.text: "You want everyone to fear you."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Juliana looking directly at Catherine, gestures restrained by the heavy iron chains.

events.label: JULIANA (Mocking, Direct):
events.text: "But look at you."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes burning with fiery contempt.

events.label: JULIANA (Stripping Her Bare):
events.text: "You have to threaten a chained woman to feel powerful!"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine trembling with uncontrollable rage, teeth bared.

events.label: CATHERINE (Choking with Rage):
events.text: "You insolent—!"

events.label: JULIANA (Steely, Triumphant):
events.text: "You may have the title you have always wanted..."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Catherine gripping the glowing tongs as Juliana continues speaking over her.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana delivering the final emotional blow.

events.label: JULIANA (Final, Condemning):
events.text: "...but you will never have the courage to earn what you demand from everyone else."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine's face twitching with sheer murderous madness.

events.label: CATHERINE (Enraged, Shouting):
events.text: "You think you can lecture me?!"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Catherine raising the branding iron high above her head with both hands.

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Catherine hoists the searing branding rod over Juliana with frantic fury.

events.label: CATHERINE (Screaming, Maniacal):
events.text: "Then let's see how brave you are when it touches your skin!"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Catherine plunging the glowing orange poker straight toward Juliana's face.

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Juliana gasps, freezing as the glowing tip of the iron thrusts forward, stopping mere millimeters from her right eye.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, unblinking blue eye. The intense, fiery orange glow of the iron poker radiates inches from her cornea, holding on the heart-stopping cliffhanger as the frame cuts to black.
